skills.name: Bombarding Leg
skills.description: Summons Spirit Ally, jumps and kicks. Bad effects on enemies.  *ATK x 3100% Area Damage  *Enemy Evade Rate -50% (7 sec) *Enemy Skill Range -30% (7 sec)

skills.name: Come Out! Lee Pyron
skills.description: Spirit Ally appears from inside a coffin. Good effects on allies.  *Skill Hit Rate +40% (7 sec) *Skill Use Rate +40%  (7 sec) *HP x 40% Area Recovery (per sec) (7 sec)

abilities.name: Group: Shaman King
abilities.description: Shaman King Tie-Up! Put Rangers of a group into a Team and HP buffs will be applied in battle. You must have a Team of at least 2 Rangers for group buffs to apply. The more Rangers you have in a Team from the same group, the stronger the buffs will be. (There are 5 buff levels.)

abilities.name: Revive
abilities.description: Rangers will have a high chance of being revived when they are defeated. Rangers will be revived with 70% HP. This Ability will only activate once.
